One object's stream

Source: R/objects.R
pdf_stream.Rd

Reads a stream object's bytes, decoded or as stored. pdfio decodes FlateDecode, with or without a PNG predictor. A stream with any other filter, such as DCTDecode (JPEG) or ASCII85Decode, is returned as stored even when decode = TRUE, with decoded = FALSE, so the caller can decode it, for example with jpeg::readJPEG().

Usage

pdf_stream(pdf, n, decode = TRUE)

Arguments

pdf

A pdf_file from pdf_open().

n

An object number, as in pdf_objects()'s number column.

decode

TRUE to decode the stream's filters, FALSE for the bytes as stored in the file.

Value

A raw vector with attributes decoded (whether the filters were applied) and filter (the stream's filter names, in order).

Details

The stream is bounded by the max_stream limit of pdf_open(), which stops a small compressed stream that inflates to gigabytes.

Examples

pdf <- pdf_open(system.file("examples", "hello.pdf", package = "zupdf"))
rawToChar(pdf_stream(pdf, 5))
#> [1] "BT /F1 12 Tf 72 720 Td (Hello from zupdf.) Tj ET"
pdf_close(pdf)
